stories.headline: Chadwick Boseman’s brothers seek to remove his widow from control of late actor’s estate - NBC News
stories.summary: Chadwick Boseman’s brothers filed a petition last week seeking control of the “Black Panther” star’s estate, accusing their brother’s widow of mismanagement and failing to distribute the assets.
stories.why: A rare public family fracture over a Black icon's $40M+ estate signals how wealth and legacy disputes can happen even within close families, making it relevant for men thinking about estate planning and family dynamics.

stories.headline: Oscar Voters Reaction to 'The Odyssey' After First Official Screenings - Variety
stories.summary: Oscar voters are reacting to Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" after the first official screenings took place in Los Angeles, New York and London.
stories.why: Nolan's $250M sci-fi epic is the last-ditch effort to prove theatrical cinema can compete with streaming; how voters respond will determine whether big-budget original films survive the next decade.

stories.headline: Jason Sudeikis’ staggering ‘Ted Lasso’ Season 4 paycheck revealed — and why he initially turned it down - Page Six
stories.summary: Sudeikis said he initially turned down a hefty “Ted Lasso” payday because “the story was told.”
stories.why: A major actor turning down $10M+ because he believed the story was finished is a rare counternarrative to Hollywood's money-grab culture, signaling creative integrity still exists but is increasingly unusual.

stories.headline: New details from Nancy Guthrie ransom demand revealed, 'Her life is in your hands': report - Fox News
stories.summary: A former Arizona reporter read new excerpts from the purported ransom notes in the Nancy Guthrie kidnapping case on the "Crime Junkie" podcast.
stories.why: This crime story exemplifies how true crime podcasts have become the dominant narrative space for real cases, overshadowing traditional journalism and reshaping how facts get distributed.

stories.headline: ‘Morning Show’ to End With Season 5 at Apple TV - Variety
stories.summary: Variety has learned that the Apple TV drama will end with its upcoming fifth season
stories.why: A prestige drama ending voluntarily after five seasons breaks the streaming model of milking shows past their prime, suggesting that legacy-building (not just subscriber metrics) is making a comeback.

stories.headline: 'Godzilla vs. Kong' star Kaylee Hottle's cause of death revealed - USA Today
stories.summary: The cause of death Kaylee Hottle has been ruled an accident, after the "Godzilla vs. Kong" actress died at 18.
stories.why: An 18-year-old actress's accidental death highlights the physical toll of Hollywood stunt work and the industry's ongoing indifference to young performers' safety, even post-Rust.
